script.problem: It has 24 words. Each line is 20 words or fewer.

Its wrong detail "Keziah" is in Job 42:14, so it isn't wrong.

terra.problem: The verse says the LORD doubled Job’s former possessions, not necessarily the possessions he had when he prayed.
The verse says Job lived 140 years after this; it does not give his total lifespan.
